content: demonnic/test-in-mudlet documentation describes a GitHub Action that runs Busted specs inside Mudlet, intended to pair with build-with-muddler and able to install a pretest package and use a supplied testsDirectory. boop already mirrors this concept manually with a pinned Mudlet AppImage, GithubTests profile, package import, AUTORUN_BUSTED_TESTS, TESTS_DIRECTORY, QUIT_MUDLET_AFTER_TESTS, and PRETEST_PACKAGE. The stack recommendation is to keep real-Mudlet Busted CI and strengthen it with project-specific gates rather than moving tests to pure Lua only.
